Surah 12: Joseph (Yusuf) has source class canonical
Joseph is brother of Joseph's younger brother
q: He said: Know ye what ye did unto Joseph and his brother in your ignorance?

s: Joseph has father his father
q: When Joseph said unto his father: O my father!

s: Joseph is imprisoned in the prison (for a time)
q: And it seemed good to them (the men-folk) after they had seen the signs (of his innocence) to imprison him for a time.

s: Joseph is subject of Joseph's imprisonment
q: And it seemed good to them (the men-folk) after they had seen the signs (of his innocence) to imprison him for a time.

s: Joseph is sold in Joseph's sale (for a low price)
q: And they sold him for a low price, a number of silver coins; and they attached no value to him.

s: Joseph interprets the interpretation of dreams (by knowledge taught by Allah)
q: He said: The food which ye are given (daily) shall not come unto you but I shall tell you the interpretation ere it cometh unto you. This is of that which my Lord hath taught me.

s: Joseph has dream the dream of Joseph
q: When Joseph said unto his father: O my father! Lo! I saw in a dream eleven planets and the sun and the moon, I saw them prostrating themselves unto me.

s: Allah is a Lord (of Joseph)
q: Thus thy Lord will prefer thee and will teach thee the interpretation of events, and will perfect His grace upon thee and upon the family of Jacob as He perfected it upon thy forefathers, Abraham and Isaac.

s: Allah is a Creator (of the heavens and the earth)
q: O my Lord! Thou hast given me (something) of sovereignty and hast taught me (something) of the interpretation of events - Creator of the heavens and the earth!

s: Allah is knower Knower
q: Lo! thy Lord is Knower, Wise.

s: Joseph has father his father
q: When Joseph said unto his father: O my father! Lo! I saw in a dream eleven planets and the sun and the moon, I saw them prostrating themselves unto me.

s: Allah is wise wisdom
q: Lo! thy Lord is Knower, Wise.

s: Allah is merciful mercy (toward those who show mercy)
q: May Allah forgive you, and He is the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.

s: Allah is protecting guardian of Joseph (in the world and the Hereafter)
q: Thou art my Protecting Guardian in the world and the Hereafter.

s: Allah reveals the Qur'an (in Arabic)
q: Lo! We have revealed it, a Lecture in Arabic, that ye may understand.

s: Allah is worshipped in faith in Allah (as the only deity)
q: The decision rests with Allah only, Who hath commanded you that ye worship none save Him.

s: Jacob is grieving for Joseph (with suppressed sorrow)
q: And he turned away from them and said: Alas, my grief for Joseph! And his eyes were whitened with the sorrow that he was suppressing.

s: Joseph's brethren are brothers of Joseph
q: When they said: Verily Joseph and his brother are dearer to our father than we are, many though we be.

s: Joseph has brother a brother of yours (from your father)
q: And when he provided them with their provision he said: Bring unto me a brother of yours from your father.

s: Joseph's brethren seeks favor your father's favour (all for you)
q: so that your father's favour may be all for you, and (that) ye may afterward be righteous folk.

s: Joseph's brethren place Joseph (in the pit)
q: Then, when they led him off, and were of one mind that they should place him in the depth of the pit

s: Joseph's brethren are sinful sin (toward Joseph and his younger brother)
q: They said: By Allah, verily Allah hath preferred thee above us, and we were indeed sinful.

s: Joseph's younger brother is brother of Joseph (paternal brother)
q: He said: Know ye what ye did unto Joseph and his brother in your ignorance?

s: the ruler of Egypt is purchased by he of Egypt
q: And he of Egypt who purchased him said unto his wife: Receive him honourably.

s: the ruler's wife desires Joseph (sexually)
q: She verily desired him, and he would have desired her if it had not been that he saw the argument of his Lord.

s: Joseph's cupbearer is a former prisoner (released from prison)
q: And he of the two who was released, and (now) at length remembered, said: I am going to announce unto you the interpretation, therefore send me forth.

s: Joseph receives wisdom (from Allah)
q: And And when he reached his prime We gave him wisdom and knowledge. Thus We reward the good.

s: Joseph's cupbearer serves the ruler of Egypt (as cupbearer)
q: As for one of you, he will pour out wine for his lord to drink

s: the pit contains Joseph (after his brothers cast him into it)
q: Then, when they led him off, and were of one mind that they should place him in the depth of the pit

s: the prison contains Joseph's fellow-prisoners (two young men)
